messages:
maria: Heads up — PR #1289 adds a lightweight KV-cache shim to the runtime. RFC attached, please don't merge until arch sign-off: https://go.redwood/rfcs/kv-cache-shim PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1289

alex: thanks — pinging @jordan and @sara for arch eyes. can you confirm SLO/regression risk?

jordan: looking now. initial read: fine, but need clarity on shard affinity and fallback behavior on node loss. can you add a short runbook section to the RFC/PR?

maria: added runbook note in PR description and linked the relevant config example. snippet:
```yaml
kv_cache:
  mode: prefix
  shard_affinity: sticky
  fallback: prefer-local
```

sara: quick q: does sticky affinity break autoscaling? if so we need an ops playbook.

rohan: CI is green (build-bot) but agree we should wait for arch signoff. @arch-team any timeline?

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅ — 3/3 successful

jordan: I can give final ack after small doc edit. tagging @maria please update the failure semantics section (how we degrade to LRU) and I'll stamp.

maria: done — added 'failure semantics: degrade to LRU fallback with metrics alert' in RFC and PR. PTAL.

jordan: :eyes: taking another look now.

jordan: LGTM — arch stamp. you can merge once CI is green and one prod-smoke passes. :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks all — I'll mark the release window.
